note: Shared contract cases for the fields a session carries: the group it belongs to, the directory its pane runs in and the task state the workflow's owner declared (ADR 0017, which amends ADR 0006 — membership is server-declared; ADR 0018 — state is written with an owner token). Each case names the published shape it conforms to; the session payloads must pass the server's own shape check (web/test/contract.test.js) and decode to the same group, directory and state in the macOS app's session model (Tests/AllMyAgentsTests/ContractTests.swift). A session without a group, a known directory or a declared state publishes null. POST /api/events refuses group, dir and state: the session's agent cannot set them.

cases.name: a session with a group and a directory
a session with neither a group nor a known directory
a mesh session carries the same group and directory
a session carries a task state on its own
